card.headline: VP Radhakrishnan to Grace SRM's 22nd Convocation 2026
card.one_liner: SRM IST's 22nd Convocation is set for August 16, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at the Dr. T. P. Ganesan Auditorium, featuring Hon'ble Vice President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan. Mandatory online registration is required for eligible Engineering & Technology graduands.
